title: Question
description: A question that several traditions actually address, with an axis their readings can be placed on. Questions — not traditions — are the unit of comparison. Comparing 'Christianity to Buddhism' is not a computation anyone can defend; comparing where two readings land on 'is the rightness of an act independent of what it yields' is. See docs/10-resonance.md.

framing_note.description: REQUIRED. Whose vocabulary the question is posed in, and which traditions it fits badly. Every comparative question is asked from somewhere; recording where is the difference between comparison and imposition.

consequence_tier.description: How much damage a wrong claim does here. 'high' means the question touches a community's identity or exclusivity claims, and every resonance on it needs sign-off from the advisory group of each tradition involved. See docs/11-guardrails.md.

fits_badly.description: Traditions for which this question is a poor fit, named openly rather than silently forced onto the axis.
